title: Training, Mentorship, and Player Health Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Team_SetTrainingScheduleOnDate (RVA 0x13256a0 / 0x1325710) manipulates a 30-byte daily training schedule record at [TrainingProfile + 0xf]..[0x2c] for date, intensity, focus, and recovery rules.
claims.falsification_note: Setting training schedule schedules the simulated progression; it does not instantly mutate player attributes.

claims.statement: Mentor_AppendPair (RVA 0x124f0f0) manages up to 10 mentorship pairs at TeamFranchiseContext+0xc with a stride of 0xcc (204 bytes) per slot, using 0xffff to represent unassigned slots.
instructions: 0x124f14c: imul rdx, rax, 0xcc (204 bytes per entry)
claims.falsification_note: A player cannot be mentee to more than one active mentor at a time.
